name: fleet-prime
description: Fleet Prime workspace UI for a pinned upstream Prime Agent runtime.

scripts.check: pnpm run check:runtime && biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && pnpm run check:installer && pnpm run check:rendering && pnpm run check:web
scripts.build:web:release: pnpm --filter @prime-agent/web build && pnpm --filter @prime-agent/web run check:bundle && node scripts/build-web-release.mjs
scripts.check:rendering: pnpm --filter @prime-agent/web-design run check:message-identities && pnpm --filter @prime-agent/web-design run check:openui && pnpm --filter @prime-agent/web-design run check:components && pnpm --filter @prime-agent/web-design run check:agent-plan-contract && pnpm --filter @prime-agent/web-design run check:registries
